head.t: Penumbra receives US FDA clearance for Lightning CAVT technology for the treatment of DVT
head.x: Penumbra has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted clearance for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) to its Lightning computer assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT) technology. The indication is supported by results from the BOLT-DVT investigational device exemption (IDE) trial.
